name: What type of wall backing is required before installing shower wall tile?

mainEntity.name: What type of wall backing is required before installing shower wall tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard drywall should never be used behind wet tile areas like showers and tub surrounds. Instead, proper installation requires a cement backer board or specialized waterproof foam board, followed by a liquid or sheet waterproofing membrane. Tile and grout shed water, but they are not completely waterproof on their own; moisture will eventually seep through hairline cracks or porous grout joints. As a finish contractor, Abraham Becerra ensures the underlying framing is sound, plumb, and properly waterproofed before setting a single piece of tile to prevent hidden rot.
acceptedAnswer.description: Showers require cement backer board or waterproof panels combined with a waterproofing membrane; standard drywall will soften and fail when exposed to moisture behind tile.
